mapper.select: select dp.PD_Name as pdName, pp.PP_Name as ppName, pp.PP_Code as ppCode, rpd.Rpd_Name as uName, rpd.Rpd_Tel as uMtel, rpd.Rpd_Number as uIdcard, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, rpd.*, c2.C_Name as ownerUnitName from Reported_Personnel_Dtl rpd left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID = rpd.Rpd_Pdid left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID = rpd.Rpd_PpId left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = rpd.Rpd_Cpy left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID = rpd.owner_unit where rpd.Rp_Id = #{rpId} order by rpd.Rpd_Sort Asc

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, pro.p_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, dp.d_name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.*, case when (pro.State !=3 and pro.State != 7 and pro.ppr_id is not null) or gms.P_Project_Stage is null then '00' else gms.P_Project_Stage end as pProjectStageOrganization from Reported_Personnel mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join gantt_milestone_statistics gms on gms.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Rp_Id left join Sys_Department dp on dp.d_id=pro.p_Competent_Department where mn.Rp_Id = #{rpId}

choose.otherwise: and (pro.P_Name_History like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%') or pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%'))
